label: Qwen3.5 4B
params_summary: 4B · 32 layers · hybrid linear attention (Gated DeltaNet 3:1 full)
notes: Same architecture as qwen3.5-0.8b (qwen35, hybrid 3:1), but the linear path **shares k heads**: k_heads 16 < v_heads 32, so each k head serves 2 v heads (grp=2). The 0.8B model is 16/16 (grp=1) and can never exercise this path.

Every shape is derived from GGUF metadata, so the loader needs no change: v_heads=ssm.time_step_rank(32), v_dim=ssm.inner_size/v_heads(4096/32=128), k_heads=ssm.group_count(16), k_dim=ssm.state_size(128).
Full layers: 4 KV heads × 256 head_dim × 2 (K+V) × 4 B = 8192 B per token per layer. Linear layers: state 32×128×128×4 plus conv window 3×8192×4 = 2195456 B, independent of context length.

Verified on DGX 2026-07-28: CPU and CUDA agree token for token on two prompts; under HOMEAI_DS4X_GDN_CHECK the CPU/GPU recurrence differs by at most 5.960e-08 element-wise across 168 chunks (docs/linear-attention-design.md §4j).

layer_weight_bytes / shared_weight_bytes are **measured**, not estimated from bits per weight: summed tensor by tensor via scripts/gguf_shard.py index, with blk.N.* counted as layer weights and everything else as shared.
Only Q4_K_M is registered. Precisions we have not downloaded stay out of variants, so no unverified number ever appears here.
